name: talos-mcp-server
description: Talos Linux cluster operations as one thin MCP tool over the official machine API.
long_description: One MCP tool with typed actions covering the Talos cluster hot path — gen_config, apply_config, bootstrap, kubeconfig, health, config_merge — plus a raw passthrough for the long tail (etcd, logs, reboot, upgrade). The backend is talosctl, the official gRPC client of the Talos machine API: an existing PATH install is preferred, otherwise the correct binary for the host is auto-installed from the official Sidero release, verified against GitHub's asset digest. The full cluster bring-up recipe ships in the MCP initialize handshake. Pairs with desktop-hypervisor-mcp for node provisioning while staying deliberately hypervisor-agnostic.
